title: Genie Agents enhancements
body:
* **Answers from accessible sources**: Users who can access only some of the volumes or MCP connections attached to a Genie Agent are no longer blocked from using it. The agent answers using only the sources that the user can access. See  [Manage data objects](/aws/en/genie-agents/set-up#manage-data).
* **Custom claims in the Monitor tab**: For Genie Agents that an app queries with an [OAuth custom identity claim](/aws/en/dev-tools/auth/oauth-custom-identity-claims#genie-example), the **Monitor** tab can now show each message's claim, so you can tell which of the app's end users asked it. Turn on the **Custom claim** column from the column picker. See [Monitor the agent](/aws/en/genie-agents/monitor#history).
* **Faster benchmark runs**: Benchmark questions now run in parallel, so benchmark evaluations finish sooner. See [Benchmarks](/aws/en/genie-agents/monitor#benchmarks).
